CONTROL

SPECIFICATION CABLE ASSEMBLY

FOR FOR

MOPEDS

1. Scope - This standard covers the dimensions and other requirements of control cable assembly comprising of flexible cables, end terminals and outer casing (sheaths and bushes) for mopeds. Cable adjusters are separately covered.
2. Construction Details A typical control cable assembly shall be as shown in the Figure.
